summaries.text: This concurrent resolution expresses that it is in the national interest for the Senate to provide its advice and consent for the ratification of the Convention on Biological Diversity.

title: Expressing the need for the Senate to provide advice and consent to ratification of the United Nations Convention on Biological Diversity.
